title: Verify the build and hot reload on Windows
body: Everything so far was built and tested on Linux only. Run cargo test --workspace, npm run build and npm run tauri dev on a Windows PC, register the MCP server and hooks, and confirm an agent session shows up on Now and can take an issue with next_task.

title: Push live updates instead of polling
body: The app polls every 4 s. Watch the database (data_version or the WAL file) and the repos' .git/worktrees and refs, and emit Tauri events so views update the moment an agent reports.

title: Playbook engine: start a task in its own worktree
body: Per-project config for the integration branch, worktree location, setup commands. next_task should hand back a ready worktree, not only a branch name. Step 3 of docs/vision.md.

title: Playbook engine: submit runs cross-vendor review and opens the PR
body: Approval classification by path and reviewer flags, review by the other vendor with a VERDICT contract, PR opened through the code-host provider, verdict recorded per patch id.

title: Playbook engine: serial land with the test gate
body: One at a time under a lock, rebase, build and gate commands, known-failures baseline, fast-forward, push, clean up the worktree. Require a passing review for the same patch id and a human approval where the playbook says so.

title: Worked example playbook
body: Write a full playbook for a made-up monorepo (per-OS integration branches, sparse worktree, several build commands, a test gate with a known-failures baseline, Codex reviews Claude, billing and release paths need a human) as docs/playbooks/example.toml, so new users see every setting in use.

title: GitHub provider for pull requests and checks
body: A provider trait over code hosts (list and open PRs, checks, reviews, merge) with GitHub and Bitbucket implementations. Nitely's own repo is on GitHub, so this is what lets it track its own PRs.

title: Signed approvals checked before landing
body: Approvals are human-only by rule but an agent with shell access could write the database. Sign approvals with a key the app keeps in the OS keychain and verify them in land.

title: One-time Linear import into native issues
body: nitely import-linear --project APP imports any Linear project into a native project, keeping its keys, states, labels and comments, so Linear can be retired.

title: Connect Cursor and Codex
body: Cursor: hooks.json events and .cursor/mcp.json. Codex: notify program and MCP config. Map their payloads into sessions like nitely hook claude does.

title: Connect-an-agent onboarding in the app
body: A button per agent that writes the hooks, registers the MCP server and adds the instruction pack to each repo of a project, with a preview of every file it changes.

title: Command palette and keyboard navigation
body: Ctrl/Cmd+K palette for issues, projects and actions; j/k in lists; shortcuts to approve, answer and move.

title: Mac build and per-OS integration branches
body: Build and sign for macOS, and let a playbook name a different integration branch per OS.
